reports.definition_of_done:
The docs do not define one end state for the product. There are four, and they disagree.

(1) CONTINUITY.md section 1 describes a dev tool plus runtime for "governed, cryptographically certified AI/agentic applications — CLI and GUI, targeting AWS, Azure, and native platforms, with an optional self-extending runtime". Section 5 is the roadmap beyond mesh slice 5.

(2) docs/audits/2026-09-completion-roadmap.md (2026-09-05, extended by #637 on 2026-10-07) sets the objective "Runtime capable of autonomous self-extensions and validation with built-in agents, maintaining PRODUCT/CORE separation". It counts as done at M6, "Commercial claims unlocked", with M7 (Learning Harness) after that. It is the only document with countable exit criteria: 46 checkboxes.

(3) docs/ProductsAndBusinessPlan.md and docs/ProductFleetImplementationRoadmap.md describe five SKUs (Cloud, Private, Enterprise, Automation, Mesh). Each phase exits on a commercial event, such as the first paying customer.

(4) docs/marketing/product-boundary.md (the CEO lock of 2026-09-19) says "Ashlar governs behavior, not intelligence". Its live path is embed, gate, package, receipts, design partner, and it states "Autonomy is not required for the company to succeed". It puts Forge, Cloud, autonomy and Learn on HOLD.

(2) and (4) conflict on whether autonomous self-extension is the goal. This report measures against (2), the nearest stated goal with countable criteria, and checks (1) and (3) item by item.

reports.definition_of_done:
The scorecard defines "done" as the end of the autonomy marketing HOLD. It lists five criteria in docs/dogfood-scorecard.md:63-76, counting 3a and 3b separately:
(1) the scorecard thresholds are met for 7 consecutive days. The four thresholds are at lines 9-61: last-N=10 scheduled sweeps at >=80% PASS; mean time-to-admit <=15 min (time to CertifiedButHeld under hold); Strict rejection rate <=70%; all of them held for >=7 consecutive days.
(2) Strict requires Ed25519 on master (PR #523).
(3a) Pipeline: >=7 dated ledger rows. In each, the sweep persisted its certification record, re-read it and verified it under Strict, and the row cites the record file and its signer fingerprint. A CI-minted key is acceptable if the row says so.
(3b) Custody: one attended dated pass signed by an operator key, verified under Strict with TrustedEd25519PublicKeys holding that operator's public key alone.
(4) A real Ashlar hygiene PR produced through the loop (propose, certify, admit, PR) and merged after human review (Self-Apply Bar, lines 88-103).
Line 3 adds that dated Strict production Ed25519 passes must appear in the ledger. The cheat sheet (docs/marketing/claims-cheat-sheet.md:81-84) and the cheat-sheet line "Dogfood PASS from CI artifacts alone" (line 75) require the rows to be LANDED on master. The thresholds are themselves marked "Proposed defaults for Project Manager / Marketing review" (scorecard:7), and no ratification is recorded.
docs/LearningHarness.md:325-332 has its own "Honesty Gate", which adds two conditions the scorecard does not have: M1-M6 complete, and the adversarial pack at 16/16. The docs therefore hold two non-identical definitions of done. This assessment scores against the scorecard, which every other doc points to.

Marketing HOLD is correct and still holds.

Landed state: on LANDED evidence nothing has moved since PR #654 (655c0b42a, 2026-09-27). The ledger holds nine dated fixture E2E PASS rows (2026-09-15 to 09-25) and one GAP (docs/dogfood-ledger.md:13-22). Every one of those PASS rows is explicitly "unverified, dev-key signed" and does not count toward 3a or 3b.

Per criterion, on landed evidence:
- Criterion 2: done.
- Criterion 1: partly met. Threshold 1 has 9 of the 10-row window (9/9 PASS); threshold 2 is met (13.9-18.7s against 15 min); threshold 3 (rejection rate) has never been measured in a ledger row; threshold 4 cannot be established while threshold 3 is unmeasured.
- 3a: 0 of 7 landed.
- 3b: 0 of 1.
- 4: not met.

What has changed on master since the scorecard's "as of 2026-09-27" status:
- #661 (615728b7a, 2026-09-28) made Ed25519 pinning configurable (CertificationTrustPolicy, ASHLAR_CERT_TRUSTED_ED25519_KEYS).
- #665 (755cf6101, 2026-09-29) built the 3a pipeline: CertificationEvidenceArchive persists the record, re-reads it and verifies it under Strict, and the workflow mints an ephemeral Ed25519 key and emits a "SWEEP EVIDENCE" citation.

Since then the scheduled workflow has run every weekday. All 13 runs from 2026-09-29 to 10-13 (11 scheduled, 2 push) reached CertifiedButHeld in 14.4-20.0s and emitted 3a citations (signer ed25519:…, pinned=false, dev-hmac=true), checked in the run logs. None of these rows has been landed: no open PR lands them and no agent-task card exists for them. They exist only as CI artifacts. The sweep logs expire after 14 days, and those for the 9-29 runs are already gone. The ledger-row artifacts, which include the record JSON, expire after 30 days, starting 2026-10-28/29.

So 3a is one owner decision plus one landing PR away: about where the record files live (workflow lines 250-254).

Caveats on the evidence:
- Every CI sweep replays one recorded proposal (rgb-hex-parse.proposal.json, the S5 qwen3.8:27b output), not a live model. Thresholds 1 and 2 therefore measure loop and infrastructure stability, not proposer quality, and threshold 3 cannot be measured from these runs.
- 3b is mechanically possible now: an operator can set ASHLAR_CERT_ED25519_KEY and pin its public key, and the archive verifies under CertificationTrustPolicy.Ambient.Strict. But it needs an attended owner run. The OperatorCertificationIdentity bridge (DECISION-identity-split.md item 3) is not on master.
- Criterion 4 has no implementation path in product code: nothing under src/ opens a PR, and the sweep holds admission. tools/autonomy-controller opens PRs, but no doc counts it toward this criterion.

Several docs are stale: the scorecard status, its ✅ marks on criteria 1 and 4, ledger line 40, cheat-sheet line 83, LearningHarness lines 314/318, and RELEASE-READINESS lines 51/125.
